items.title: 3444 N 4500 E
items.description: Country charm meets modern comfort! Idaho acreage property! If you've been dreaming of a place where there's room to breathe, mature trees and the pace of life slows down just enough to enjoy it; this beautifully updated farmhouse in Murtaugh is the one you've been waiting for. Situated on 1.31 acres, this inviting two-story home offers 1,856 square feet with 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and the perfect blend of timeless character and thoughtful updates. Inside, you'll love the refreshed kitchen with lots of storage, walk in pantry, double ovens, propane oven/range, fridge, dishwasher & microwave. Comfortable living spaces designed for everyday life. Newer mini-split systems provide efficient year-round comfort. Upstairs bathroom has a walk in tile shower. Step outside and imagine mornings on the covered front porch, evenings relaxing under the gazebo and weekends enjoying the shade of mature trees that create your own private retreat. The detached garage/shop offers endless possibilities for hobbies, projects, extra storage, or parking, while the additional storage shed keeps all your outdoor equipment organized. With plenty of room for gardening, animals, toys, RVs or simply enjoying the space, this property offers the freedom that's becoming harder to find. Close to Twin Falls or Burley activities. Setup a showing of this property today.
items.listingOffice: Super Realty of Idaho Super Realty of Idaho

items.title: 192 W Caswell
items.description: Affordable, centrally located, and ready for its next chapter! This 2-bedroom, 2-bath manufactured home offers 1,144 sq ft of comfortable living space on a permanent foundation in a convenient central Twin Falls location. An attached 1-car garage provides additional parking and storage. Several of the big-ticket improvements have already been completed, including a new roof and HVAC system in 2024, plus central air for year-round comfort. Inside, the home is ready for a new owner to bring their own style and updates, creating a great opportunity to build equity and make the space their own. Conveniently located near shopping, schools, dining, and everyday amenities, this property offers an affordable path to homeownership without sacrificing location. Whether you’re looking for a primary residence, downsizing, or searching for an investment opportunity, 192 W Caswell Ave is full of potential. Priced to sell—don’t miss your opportunity to make this Twin Falls home your own!

The kitchen has stunning custom black walnut cabinets, granite countertops, tasteful tile backsplashes, undercabinet lighting, full Samsung appliance package, including a french door refridgerator, and an overall upscale finish. Fireplace is an electric insert offering aesthetics and warmth. A completely finished 2-car garage with enclosed furnace room and insulated garage doors. Exterior is Stucco with stone accents, vinyl siding on sides and back, full raingutters, and complete landscaping. Fully fenced yard with sprinklers, curbing, sodded lawn in front & seeded lawn in the back. It has a covered back patio, perfect for relaxing evenings. Additional perks include insulated interior walls and LED can-lighting throughout.

items.title: 1280 E 4340 N
items.description: Yes this parcel comes with ground water rights - Irrigate up to 4 acres through the existing well from April-October. Easement access runs through neighboring property, shut all cattle gates and be respectful of their land. GPS coordinates are 42.627592, -114.796668. LOOK AT THE PHOTOS FOR DIRECTIONS TO THE CORRECT ACCESS ROAD. Don't get yourself in trouble. Don't knock on neighboring homes. Address is county approx, not accurate. From Hwy 30, turn North down Carter Pack Rd (1325 E). At Bartlett corner where Carter Pack continues as 4325 N, you'll get off the pavement and continue on 1325 E on a dirt road that goes uphill. Access road is on the right side, look for the machetes on the fence post. Go through the first cattle gate. There's another gate and a ditch before you're on the property. There is an existing well (needs new pump) and septic tank. Ask ME or your agent for specifics. This is probably as good a deal as you'll ever find on land with water rights! Buyer to verify all info.

items.title: 1228 Evergreen Dr
items.description: Some homes are simply lived in, this one is where memories are made. From summer afternoons spent lounging by the in-ground pool to evenings gathered around one of three fireplaces, this remarkable 3,223-square-foot mid-century home was designed for bringing people together. Situated on a beautifully landscaped .257-acre lot, the inviting front yard even features a charming tree swing that perfectly captures the warmth and character found throughout the property. Inside, you’ll discover 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms and an abundance of flexible living spaces that make entertaining effortless. Whether you’re hosting holiday celebrations, game nights, movie marathons, or quiet evenings with family, there’s room for everyone to spread out and feel at home. Expansive windows fill the home with natural light, highlighting the timeless mid-century architecture and welcoming atmosphere. Three fireplaces, including two wood-burning fireplaces and one gas fireplace, create cozy gathering spaces throughout every season. The spacious kitchen offers generous workspace and flows seamlessly into the home’s multiple living and dining areas, making it ideal for entertaining on any scale. 3 of the bathrooms offer step in showers. Located near schools, shopping and everyday conveniences, this is more than just a beautiful home, it’s the one everyone will want to gather at. Setup a private showing today.

The kitchen is ready for everyday living with updated appliances, granite countertops, abundant cabinet space, and plenty of room to prepare your favorite meals. Major updates include a new roof installed in 2023, providing added peace of mind for years to come. Step outside to enjoy the beautifully established landscaping, ample yard space for outdoor activities and the convenience of RV parking for your toys, trailer, or extra vehicles. Located within the Pillar Falls Elementary School attendance area and close to parks, this move-in-ready home offers the perfect combination of location and livability. Don’t miss your opportunity to own this exceptional property. Schedule your private showing today before it’s gone!

items.title: 4531 N 1250 E
items.description: Some views never get old. Perched on more than 6 acres overlooking the breathtaking Snake River Canyon, this extraordinary property offers the kind of panoramic scenery most people only experience on vacation. If you've been searching for privacy, space, and unforgettable Idaho sunsets, you've just found it. This beautifully designed single-level home offers 1,923 square feet with 4 bedrooms, a dedicated office, 2 bathrooms and a layout that was built to showcase the incredible surroundings. The vaulted great room features rich bamboo flooring, a cozy fireplace and an impressive wall of windows that frames the canyon like a living work of art. The spacious kitchen comes fully equipped with all major appliances, including a refrigerator and double ovens, making it perfect for entertaining family and friends. Escape to the private primary suite featuring direct access to the covered patio, dual vanities, a relaxing soaker tub, walk-in shower, and the same spectacular views that make this property so special. A 3-car garage provides plenty of room for vehicles, toys, and outdoor gear. Whether you're enjoying your morning coffee as the sun rises over the canyon or ending the day beneath Idaho's colorful skies, this isn't simply a home, it's a front-row seat to one of the most breathtaking landscapes in the Northwest. Schedule your private showing today and experience it for yourself.
